title: Chrome Extension
subtitle: Download Pinterest content with one click

hero.title: PinDownloader Chrome Extension
hero.description: Install our Chrome extension for the fastest way to download Pinterest content. Add a download button directly to Pinterest pages.

features.title: One-Click Downloads
features.description: Download button appears directly on Pinterest pages. No need to copy and paste URLs.

features.title: Lightweight & Fast
features.description: Minimal resource usage. Won't slow down your browser.

features.title: Safe & Secure
features.description: Only requests necessary permissions. No data collection or tracking.

features.title: Multiple Formats
features.description: Download videos, images, and GIFs in various quality options.

features.title: Customizable
features.description: Configure default quality settings and download location.

features.title: Always Updated
features.description: Regular updates to ensure compatibility with Pinterest changes.

steps.title: Download the Extension
steps.description: Click the download button above or visit the Chrome Web Store.

steps.title: Install in Chrome
steps.description: If downloaded as ZIP, extract it and load it in Chrome via chrome://extensions/ with Developer Mode enabled. Or install directly from Web Store.

steps.title: Pin the Extension
steps.description: Click the puzzle icon in Chrome toolbar and pin PinDownloader for easy access.

steps.title: Start Downloading
steps.description: Visit any Pinterest page and click the download button that appears on pins.

videoTutorial.title: Video Tutorial
videoTutorial.description: Watch our step-by-step video guide on installing and using the Chrome extension.

faq.question: Is the extension free?
faq.answer: Yes, the Chrome extension is completely free, just like our website.

faq.question: What permissions does it need?
faq.answer: The extension only needs permission to access Pinterest pages and communicate with our download API. We don't collect any personal data.

faq.question: Will it slow down my browser?
faq.answer: No, the extension is very lightweight and only activates on Pinterest pages.

faq.question: Can I use it on other browsers?
faq.answer: Currently, we only support Chrome and Chromium-based browsers (Edge, Brave, etc.). Firefox support is coming soon.

faq.question: How do I report a bug?
faq.answer: Use the 'Report Issue' link in the extension popup or contact us through our contact page.
